name: Crispy Golden Dosa & Velvet Chutney
description: Fermented rice-lentil crepes cooked crisp with ghee, served alongside fresh coconut-coriander chutney.
instructions: Blend grated coconut, green chillies, salt, and water into a smooth paste.
Heat half the ghee in a small pan, crackle mustard seeds, curry leaves, and hing, then pour over chutney.
Heat a flat non-stick tawa on medium-high heat and brush lightly with ghee.
Pour a ladleful of batter in the center and spread outward in circular motions into a thin disc.
Drizzle ghee around the edges and cook until the bottom turns golden brown and crisp.

name: Royal Shekhawati Dal Tadka
description: High-protein yellow pigeon pea stew infused with turmeric and tempered with cumin ghee.
instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with water, turmeric, and salt for 4 whistles until completely tender.
Heat ghee in a pan, add cumin seeds, and let them crackle.
Add ginger-garlic paste and chopped tomatoes; sauté until tomatoes soften and oil separates.
Pour the cooked yellow dal into the tempering, adjust consistency with warm water, and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: Nawab's Jain Paneer Makhan Malai
description: Succulent cottage cheese cubes simmered in a velvety tomato, melon seed, and cashew gravy without onion or garlic.
instructions: Heat butter in a pan, add tomato puree, and cook on medium heat until reduced.
Stir in cashew-melon seed paste and cook until gravy leaves the sides of the pan.
Add 1/2 cup warm water, salt, garam masala, and bring to a gentle boil.
Add paneer cubes, crush Kasuri Methi between palms and sprinkle on top, simmer for 4 minutes.
Finish with fresh cream and serve hot with phulkas.

name: Indori Zesty Poha Delight
description: Feather-light steamed flattened rice tempered with mustard, fennel seeds, turmeric, and topped with crisp sev.
instructions: Rinse poha in a colander under running water for 30 seconds; drain completely and toss with sugar, salt, and turmeric.
Heat oil in a pan, crackle mustard and fennel seeds, then sauté chopped onions until translucent.
Add rinsed poha, cover with a lid, and steam on low heat for 3 minutes.
Drizzle fresh lemon juice and garnish with Ratlami sev and fresh coriander.

name: Guajarati Khatta Meetha Moong
description: Wholesome whole green gram curry lightly sweetened with jaggery and balanced with lemon zest.
instructions: Pressure cook soaked green moong with salt and water for 3 whistles until cooked but firm.
Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds, then add red chilli powder, coriander-cumin powder, and cooked moong.
Stir in jaggery and 1/2 cup water; simmer for 5-7 minutes until flavours blend.
Turn off heat and stir in lemon juice before serving with hot khakhra or roti.

name: Kashmiri Chana Palak Power Bowl
description: Iron and protein-packed curry pairing soft chickpeas with pureed spiced spinach.
instructions: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, plunge into ice water, and puree smoothly.
Heat oil in a pan, sauté chopped garlic until golden, then add tomato puree and spices.
Add boiled chickpeas and spinach puree; mix well and cook on medium heat for 8 minutes.
Adjust salt and serve hot with steamed jeera rice.

name: Jain Malai Raw Banana Kebab
description: Pan-seared spiced raw banana patties stuffed with soft paneer and herbs.
instructions: Mix mashed raw banana, cornflour, amchur, green chilli paste, and salt into a smooth dough.
Divide into small balls, flatten into discs, and stuff the center with grated paneer.
Seal edges and shape into round patties.
Shallow fry on a non-stick pan with minimal oil until golden and crisp on both sides.

name: Maharashtrian Sabudana Pearl Khichdi
description: Fluffy, non-sticky sago pearls tossed with roasted peanut coarse powder and green chillies.
instructions: Mix soaked sabudana pearls with coarse roasted peanut powder and salt in a bowl.
Heat ghee in a pan, crackle cumin seeds, and add chopped green chillies.
Add sabudana-peanut mix and cook on low heat, stirring gently until pearls turn translucent.
Drizzle fresh lemon juice, garnish with coriander, and serve immediately.

name: Jain Lauki Kofta Curry
description: Tender bottle gourd dumplings poached in a rich curd and gram flour tempered curry.
instructions: Squeeze excess water from grated lauki, mix with besan and spices, shape into balls, and steam for 10 minutes.
Whisk curd with besan (1 tbsp), turmeric, chilli powder, and 1 cup water to make a smooth base.
Heat ghee, temper with cumin, pour curd mixture, and stir continuously until it comes to a gentle boil.
Add steamed lauki koftas into the simmering curry and cook for 5 minutes.

name: Banarasi Matar Ghugni Sensation
description: Fresh sweet green peas sautéed with ginger, black pepper, and roasted cumin.
instructions: Heat mustard oil in a pan until smoky; reduce heat and add grated ginger.
Add fresh green peas, salt, and 2 tbsp water; cover and cook on low heat for 8 minutes until tender.
Uncover, sprinkle black pepper and roasted cumin powder, and toss on high heat for 2 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and serve warm with evening tea.
